newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $67 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $67 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in Panhandle area early Wednesday turning slow by Noon as most showlists were depleted, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers steady to mostly $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 5,800 slaughter steers and 1,400 heifers; 100,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 17,800 formulated and 1,200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs
66.00 to mostly 67.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice
Wk to Date - 100,400 Week Ago - 59,900 Year Ago - 83,000
